questions.q: Before opening an outdoor unit for repair, what must you do first?

options: Gas और तेल बाहर निकलकर आग पकड़ सकते हैं

options: AC volts లో చెక్ చేసి లాగేయాలి

Pipe से सीटी की आवाज़ आने तक भरें

hi.q: जहां बिजली ऊपर-नीचे होती है, वहां AC के साथ stabiliser क्यों लगाते हैं?

task.title: AC service and safety check, with an optional photo of your work
task.brief: This takes about 10 minutes. First answer the picture-style questions about safe and correct AC installation and service. Pick the answer you would really follow on the job. Then, if you like, upload one clear photo of an AC you installed or serviced (neat piping, outdoor stand, flare joints, wiring) or your ITI / refrigeration certificate. Do not show any faces in the photo. Add one or two lines: what the job was, the AC type and gas, and one safety step you took. The photo is optional, but it helps employers trust your skill.
key_points: Photo shows real AC installation or service work, or a certificate
Says what the job was, the AC type and gas used
Work looks neat: proper piping, drain slope, secure stand and wiring

rubric.label: Relevance
rubric.guide: 0 = no photo or not AC work, 3 = AC work but unclear, 5 = clear photo of the candidate's own AC job or certificate

rubric.label: Genuineness
rubric.guide: 0 = looks copied from the internet, 3 = plausible but no details, 5 = clearly own work with job details that fit the photo

rubric.label: Work quality
rubric.guide: 0 = messy or unsafe fitting, 3 = acceptable, 5 = neat piping, insulation, stand and wiring

rubric.label: Safety
rubric.guide: 0 = unsafe practice shown or faces visible, 3 = no issues seen, 5 = safety steps clearly described or visible
